description: This file defines a generic interface 'Entry' used as a cache entry for authorization-related data, including methods for creating permanent, specific revision, and nonexistent entries, as well as retrieval methods for revision and value.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: A generic interface representing a cache entry with revision control and value retrieval methods.

methods.name: permanent
methods.description: Creates a cache entry that is considered permanent with the maximum revision value.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a cache entry with a specified revision number and value.

methods.name: nonexistent
methods.description: Creates a cache entry that indicates the absence of a value.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the cache entry.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if the cache entry actually holds a value.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves the cached value if present; throws NoSuchElementException if not.
